steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In October 2026, Equity Mates described Axon’s body cameras and evidence.com as sticky because footage from police, bystanders and shops is centralised and used through the justice system, and noted expansion into 911 dispatch, real-time operations and drones alongside growing overseas adoption and AI use.

In May 2026, a guest on Equity Mates outlined Axon’s shift from Tasers to body cameras, giving cameras away so officers dock and upload footage daily to a cloud platform, creating an embedded service.

episode.title: How AI improves the investing process with Arms Rosenberg

views.text: In February 2023, Equity Mates said US policymakers pushed funding for police accountability, with a request for $35 billion noted, and framed Axon’s move from Tasers to body cameras and a cloud evidence platform as positioned to benefit from that focus.

episode.title: Stock of the Year 2023 | Axon Enterprise vs Infosys

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In October 2026, Equity Mates reported Axon beat forecasts in Q1 2026 but was caught in a wider policing technology backlash and saw gross margins dip, highlighting both momentum and profitability pressure.

In August 2026, Equity Mates noted 10 consecutive quarters of 30% plus growth, AI product revenue up 700% year on year, and international revenue doubling to 20%, supporting the case for sustained, above-market profitability.

episode.title: Banks flag a housing slowdown, AI won’t pick your stocks & Ren’s portfolio reviewed

views.text: In February 2023, Equity Mates said Axon held about 85% body camera share in major US cities and that 90% of the 18,000 US police departments used its Tasers, indicating strong competitive positioning.

episode.title: Stock of the Year 2023 | Axon Enterprise vs Infosys

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In October 2026, Equity Mates said Axon reinvested to expand beyond cameras into 911 dispatch, operations command, drones and AI, while growing internationally across broader public safety workflows.
In August 2026, Equity Mates highlighted results showing revenue up 35%, guidance lifted to 34% growth, and AI revenue up 700%, presenting AI investment as a key growth driver.

In May 2026, Equity Mates compared another company’s strategy to Axon’s earlier pivot into SaaS with evidence.com and body cameras, describing Axon’s shift as a wonderful move toward recurring revenue.

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In April 2026, Equity Mates said Axon had long been very expensive and had been caught up in the AI selloff, which they described as overblown.
